answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 10215 Country: Pakistan Title: asslam o alikum. may aap say yeh poochna chahta hoon k kia moharram ka dino may maatam karna jaiz ha Question: asslam o alikum. may aap say yeh poochna chahta hoon k kia moharram ka dino may maatam karna jaiz ha Answer ID: 10215 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 54/54=D/1429) Mourning and wailing ( matam ) is un-Islamic and the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) cursed those doing so. (Mishkawt) Mourning in Muharram is from the bad innovations of the Shias, the Muslims should shun completely from it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
